## Silver Dragon, Wyrm (CR 20)

**XP** 307,200  
 LG Gargantuan dragon (cold)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** dragon senses, fog vision; Perception +37; **Aura** cold (10 ft., 1d6 cold), frightful presence (330 ft., DC 30)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 40, touch 4, flat-footed 40 (-2 Dex, +36 natural, -4 size)  
 **hp** 540 (27d12+216)  
 **Fort** +22, **Ref** +15, **Will** +24  
 **Defensive Abilities** reflective scales; **DR** 20/magic; **Immune** acid, cold, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 31  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 250 ft. (poor); cloudwalking, graceful flight  
 **Melee** bite +37 (4d6+19/19–20), 2 claws +36 (2d8+13), tail slap +34 (2d8+19), 2 wings +34 (2d6+6)  
 **Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. cone, DC 30, 22d8 cold), crush (4d6+19, DC 30), paralyzing breath, tail sweep (2d6+19, DC 30)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 27th; concentration +34)  

  
  At will—
  *control weather, control winds, detect evil, feather fall, fog cloud*
  
 **Spells Known** (CL 17th; concentration +24)  

  
  8th (4/day)—
  *greater spell immunity, holy aura* (DC 25)
  

  7th (7/day)—
  *[greater scrying](../../magic/spells/scrying-greater.md)*,
  *[holy word* ](../../magic/spells/holy-word.md)(DC 24),
  *[repulsion* ](../../magic/spells/repulsion.md)(DC 24)
  

  6th (7/day)—
  *[banishment* ](../../magic/spells/banishment.md)(DC 23),
  *greater dispel magic, heal*
  

  5th (7/day)—
  *break enchantment, flame strike* (DC 22)
  *, plane shift, wall of force*
  

  4th (7/day)—
  *dimension door, freedom of movement, restoration, solid fog*
  

  3rd (8/day)—
  *cure serious wounds, dispel magic, hold person* (DC 20),
  *[wind wall](../../magic/spells/wind-wall.md)*
  

  2nd (8/day)—
  *augury, calm emotions* (DC 19),
  *cure moderate wounds, invisibility, web* (DC 19)
  

  1st (8/day)—
  *bless, divine favor, protection from evil, shield, true strike*
  

  0 (at will)—
  *detect magic, flare* (DC 17),
  *light, message, prestidigitation, read magic, stabilize, resistance, virtue

* Note: A silver dragon can cast cleric spells as arcane spells
  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 37, **Dex** 6, **Con** 25, **Int** 24, **Wis** 25, **Cha** 24  
 **Base Atk** +27; **CMB** +44; **CMD** 52 (56 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Critical Focus, Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lighting Reflexes, Multiattack, Quicken Spell, Skill Focus (Fly), Snatch, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +25 (+29 jump), Diplomacy +37, Fly +24, Heal +37, Intimidate +37, Knowledge (arcana, history, local, nobility, planes) +37, Perception +37, Sense Motive +37, Spellcraft +37  
 **Languages** Auran, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Halfling, Giant, Terran  
 **SQ** change shape  

**Special Abilities**

 **Change Shape (Su)** A silver dragon can assume any animal or humanoid form 3/day as if using *polymorph*.  

 **Cloudwalking (Su)**
